summary: A small armoured catfish that searches the bottom for food and is best observed in a group. Traditionally sold as Corydoras aeneus, it is now placed in Osteogaster; albino aquarium strains are also common.
nativeRange: Northern South America and Trinidad and Tobago; some older records farther south refer to related or introduced fish.

features: Body protected by rows of bony plates.
Metallic bronze-green sides and barbels around the mouth; albino strains lack the normal dark pigment.
Small barbels surround the mouth for probing the substrate.

habitat.description: Shallow streams and pools, including soft-bottomed quiet waters.
habitat.diet: Small invertebrates, worms, detritus and algae; provide sinking food rather than relying on leftovers.
